name: claude-code-no-auto-attach
description: Patches the Claude Code VS Code extension: auto-attach defaults to OFF (configurable), Ctrl+F context-attach toggle, session-scoped model switching, session-scoped effort switching, configurable quick-send slots (model + effort) behind three colored send buttons, Ctrl+0/1/2/3 and Ctrl+M, per-session model badge, capped/scrollable prompt bubbles, markdown-preview context attach, vscode://…/open URIs open in the locked Claude editor group and auto-send their prompt. Voice-dictated prompts are cleaned up by Haiku (fillers, stutters, broken words) when the recording stops. Re-applies automatically when Claude Code updates.

commands.title: Claude Code No Auto-Attach: Reapply Patch
Claude Code No Auto-Attach: Revert Patch

claude-code-no-auto-attach.detachContext.description: Start new Claude Code sessions with the current file/selection NOT attached as context (the original reason for this extension). Turn OFF to keep upstream behavior (attached by default). Either way, Ctrl+F toggles the attachment while a Claude session is focused. Applied by patching, so changing it re-applies the patch and prompts a window reload.

claude-code-no-auto-attach.autoApprovePr.description: Auto-approve Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit/Bash prompts that fire against Claude's own protected paths (e.g. .claude/, ~/.claude/settings.json) despite bypassPermissions. Fires while permission mode is bypassPermissions (or before any setPermissionMode call has happened in the session). Only enable in trusted workspaces.

claude-code-no-auto-attach.sessionScoped.description: Make model switching session-scoped: selecting a model in a Claude Code session no longer rewrites the global default in ~/.claude/settings.json. Toggle OFF temporarily if you want a model switch to become the new global default. Takes effect immediately, no reload needed.

claude-code-no-auto-attach.uriOpensInEdi.description: Make vscode://anthropic.claude-code/open?prompt=…&session=… URIs open/resume in the locked editor group you keep Claude Code in (creating and locking a side column when there is none) instead of hijacking the active editor group. The injected code reads the setting on every URI, so toggling takes effect immediately, no reload needed.

claude-code-no-auto-attach.uriAutoSendsP.description: When a vscode://anthropic.claude-code/open URI carries a prompt (and uriOpensInEditor is on), send it right away instead of just typing it into the composer. Waits for the session to be idle; gives up after 30s and leaves the prompt typed.

claude-code-no-auto-attach.sessionScoped.description: Make effort switching session-scoped: changing the effort level (via the native picker or a quick-send slot) no longer rewrites the global default in ~/.claude/settings.json. Toggle OFF temporarily if you want an effort change to become the new global default. Takes effect immediately, no reload needed.

claude-code-no-auto-attach.voiceCleanup..markdownDescription: When a Claude Code dictation stops, have Haiku clean up the dictated text: remove fillers (uh, um, you know), stutters, repeated words and false starts, fix words the speech-to-text clearly broke, and join fragments into full sentences, leaving the wording otherwise alone. Runs Claude Code's own `claude` binary with your login (no API key), in about a second; the composer pulses meanwhile. Sending while it runs waits for the cleaned text (3s at most), typing before it finishes keeps the raw text, and `Cmd+Z` brings it back after. Read on every recording, no reload needed.

claude-code-no-auto-attach.quickSend.pur.markdownDescription: Model that the purple send button and `Ctrl+0` switch the session to. `Ctrl+M` and a click on the model badge go through the slots in shortcut order. Read at runtime, no reload needed.

enumDescriptions: Leave the session's effort as it is (the model's default from `modelSettings` until you pick one).
claude-code-no-auto-attach.quickSend.pur.markdownDescription: Effort that the purple send button and `Ctrl+0` set, session-scoped. Skipped when the model doesn't support that level.
